profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Several years technical experience in developing Java web applications(J2EE), web services for Enterprise Content Manager System including EMC, IBM, Alfresco products. Eager to adapt to new technology and find a way to make projects more productive.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Work on PECO and connectopensource.org(which implements the Nationwide Health Information Network (NwHIN) standards and specifications).  https://github.com/CONNECT-Solution/CONNECT

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description: Implement Alfresco workflow, webservice for Veterans Affairs (VA) Project.

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description: My primary duties are to integrate IBM Enterprise Content Management (ECM) into Medical Appeal System for Center Medicare & Medicaid Service (CMS). Some of my accomplishment includes developing a custom web service by using Apache CXF to allow a Siebel application to manipulate electronic documents that store inside IBM repository. In addition, I also design and build a new custom Java Spring framework web application to replace the old, existing web application. The new Spring-framework web application allows user to upload multiple documents and to generate document status report by integrating Google WebTool Kit (GWT) and Jasper Report. I also assist on content migration effort by implementing Producer/Consumer pattern to increase speed. Some of patterns that I also implement are publish-subscribe pattern by using IBM Java Message Service (JMS) to help users to know who modify document when multiple users simultaneously open documents.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: To provide technical expertise on EMC Enterprise Documentum System to various clients including FAA, EPA, WMATA, LAWA,and Fairfax County. Some of my tasks includes using EMC Business Process Manager (BPM) to implement workflow to meet user business requirements, creating various web services to expose EMC functionalities to the third party web applications.  I also design and develop web applications to store document into the EMC repository
